projects.title: SchoolDesk
projects.description: A full-stack school management platform connecting administrators, teachers, parents, and students in one unified system.
projects.overview: SchoolDesk is a comprehensive school management platform built to digitize academics, finance, transport, and communication for 200+ schools. Trusted by pilot schools in Hyderabad & Bengaluru.
projects.challenge: Schools were relying on fragmented tools — spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and paper records — causing delays, data loss, and poor parent communication.
projects.solution: We built a unified platform with role-based dashboards for administrators, teachers, parents, and students — covering attendance, fees, academics, transport, and real-time communication in one product.
